title: docs(rest,app-crm): the public form submit is authorized by its declaration, not by a guest_portal set
body:
Fixes #24130

Clause-②: no

## What changes

Comments, one published docstring, one docs paragraph, and a `patch` changeset. No behaviour of the form routes changes.

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` — the JSDoc above `registerFormEndpoints`, and nothing else in the file. It said security is delegated to the `guest_portal` set, that a deployment without one "falls open", and that secure-by-default deployments must pair the routes with one. It now states the mechanism the runtime runs: the declaration-derived `publicFormGrant` is admitted before any permission set resolves; it says what the grant admits, refuses and strips, and what the `guest_portal` name on the context reaches.
- `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` — three comments:
  - the route header ("with the `guest_portal` permission set attached");
  - the stale `lead.hook.ts` / `case.hook.ts` pointer;
  - the comment above the submit context ("`guest_portal` + `anonymous` are kept for back-compat with object hooks").
- `examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts` — the `web_to_lead` comment no longer says the `guest_portal` profile authorizes the write.
- `examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts` — `GuestPortalProfile` is **kept**, and its comment now says why (H3 below).
- `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` — one paragraph in section 2 saying what the `guest_portal` name on the submit context does and does not do.
- `.changeset/24130-form-submit-docstring.md` — `@objectstack/rest`: `patch`. The docstring ships; measured below.

## Measured

Tree: `c564b0e45`, the merge of `origin/main` `2bcd406a2` into this branch.

### H1 — what authorizes the anonymous INSERT, and what `permissions: ['guest_portal']` does

I read `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` and did not change it.

- **Admission.** The middleware's `publicFormGrant` branch admits `insert` / `find` / `findOne` / `count` on the grant's object and throws `PermissionDeniedError` for any other operation or object. It decides this before any permission set resolves, and it strips `PUBLIC_FORM_SERVER_MANAGED_FIELDS` from inserted rows.
- **The `guest_portal` name.** The branch then calls `resolvePermissionSetsForContext(opCtx.context)`, which requests the context's `permissions` names by name. The answer is used only as input to `resolveCallerPosture` and `maskOperationResult` over the operation's result.
- **What a registered set contributes.** The masker reads the set's `fields` (`getFieldPermissions`) and its system permissions (`getSystemPermissions`, held against a field's `requiredPermissions`). The set's `objects` bits are never read on this branch.
- **What the visitor sees.** The route answers `{ id }` only.

Live check: a real boot of `examples/app-crm`, through `bootStack` from `@objectstack/verify`, in a throwaway dogfood probe that is not committed. It ran with and without `GuestPortalProfile` in the stack's `permissions`:

| probe | with `GuestPortalProfile` | without |
|---|---|---|
| permission sets the stack declares | `crm_sales_user`, `guest_portal` | `crm_sales_user` |
| clean `POST /forms/contact-us/submit` | `201`, body `{ id }` | `201`, body `{ id }` |
| `POST` that also sends `status: 'qualified'`, `lead_score: 99`, and forged `owner_id` / `organization_id` | `201`, body `{ id }` | `201`, body `{ id }` |
| both stored rows, read as system | `status: new`, `lead_score: 0`, `source: web`, `owner_id: null`, forged organization not stored | same |
| anonymous `GET /data/crm_lead` | `401` | `401` |
| anonymous `GET /data/crm_lead/ID` | `401` | `401` |
| a `beforeInsert` hook on `crm_lead`, `ctx.session` / `ctx.user` | `null` / `null` | `null` / `null` |

The probe asserted the two shapes' answers equal and passed (`Tests 1 passed`). This matches the card's measurement on 17.7.0.

A second throwaway probe ran at the engine level (`packages/objectql`, not committed):

- **Route context.** With the route's context verbatim, a `beforeInsert` hook's `ctx.session` and `ctx.user` are both unset.
- **Positive control.** A context with `userId: 'u_ctl'`, `positions: ['p_ctl']`, `permissions: ['guest_portal']`, `anonymous: true` reaches the hook as `session: { userId, positions }` and `user: { id }`. Neither `permissions` nor `anonymous` gets through, because `buildSession` / `buildUser` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` copy neither key.

So "kept for back-compat with object hooks" was false: no hook can read either key.

### H2 — the hook-file pointer

`examples/app-crm/src/hooks/` holds `index.ts` and `opportunity.hook.ts` only. Neither `lead.hook.ts` nor `case.hook.ts` exists. The comment now names the three patterns that do exist:

- a field's `defaultValue` (`crm_lead.status`);
- on a select that declares no `defaultValue`, its `default: true` option. `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (about `:7086`): "A field that declares NO `defaultValue` falls back to the option marked `default: true`." This is how `source` lands as `web` in the table above;
- a `beforeInsert` hook where the value needs logic: `StampInquiryDefaultsHook` in `examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts`, the hook on the showcase's public-form target.

### H3 — `GuestPortalProfile`: kept, and the example says why

The dispatch preferred dropping the profile if nothing reads it. Two things read it:

- The grant's masker resolves the set by name on every form submit (H1).
- ADR-0138 (Accepted) records this exact declaration in its fate table: "the form doors' `guest_portal` set name | `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts#RestServer.registerFormEndpoints`; the reference declaration is `examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts#GuestPortalProfile` | live: the form doors' context names that set, and the result masker resolves it where a deployment registers one … | **keep**".

Dropping the profile would leave an accepted record citing a deleted symbol, and correcting the ADR is a Tier H edit outside this card's surface. So the example keeps it.

Its comment now says:

- what it does not do: authorize the form;
- what the name reaches: the masker's field permissions;
- that, as declared here (object bits only), it changes nothing on the form path. The table above shows this.

`security/index.ts`, `objectstack.config.ts` and `access-matrix.json` are unchanged.

### Changeset — `patch`, because the docstring ships

`registerFormEndpoints` is private, but its docstring is in the published files. After the build:

- the new phrase "admits on that grant alone" appears once each in `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts`, `index.d.cts`, `index.js` and `index.cjs`;
- the old phrase "falls open with" appears zero times;
- control: a pre-existing `form-routes.ts` body comment (`Symmetric with #6601`) is in `src` once and in `dist` zero times, and so is the new `form-routes.ts` text.

So a reader of the published `@objectstack/rest` sees the corrected docstring, and that takes a `patch`, not `skip-changeset`. `examples/app-crm` is `private: true`.

## Tests and gates (head `c564b0e45`)

- **① Build.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/dogfood --filter=@objectstack/example-crm --concurrency=2` covers rest's dependency closure plus rest, plugin-security and verify. Result: `Tasks: 66 successful, 66 total`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - The CRM's `objectstack build` ran in the same run: `✓ Build complete`, `Security: 3 Positions  2 Permissions`, with no access-matrix drift.
- **② Package tests.**
  - `@objectstack/rest` `vitest run --project local`: `Test Files 294 passed (294)`, `Tests 6028 passed | 326 skipped (6354)`, exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/rest` `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/example-crm` `vitest run`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 46 passed (46)`, exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/example-crm` `typecheck`: exit 0.
- **③ Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 93 commands. All 93 exit 0.
  - On the first pass, two exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, unbuilt packages outside this closure): `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. I built the eight packages they named, re-ran both, and both exited 0.
  - `--ran`: "Run reconciliation — 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN."
- **Lint on the changed files.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the four changed `.ts` files: exit 0, no output.
- **Not run locally.** `test:repo` and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` are CI's.

## Patch round 1

The seat's review of `c564b0e45` folded two adjacent sites into this PR. The claim's file surface was revised in place: comment 6243651386, "Revised 2026-10-18T01:09Z". Head: `91ca7f3b7`.

`main` moved 5 commits since `2bcd406a2`, none on a file this PR touches, so it was not merged in. Each round-0 sentence above still describes `c564b0e45`, and nothing in it changed.

- **`content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`, the `guest_portal` passages only.**
  - The ADR-0056 callout no longer says the set and the `anonymous` flag are attached "for back-compat" with object hooks. It now says neither key authorizes anything or reaches an object hook.
  - Section 2, "(Optional) Create the `guest_portal` permission set", is **kept, retitled and rewritten**: "No permission set to create — what the `guest_portal` name does". It now says what is true:
    - admission is the declaration-derived `publicFormGrant`, decided before any set resolves;
    - a registered set's object bits are not read on this path;
    - only its field permissions, and the capabilities it holds against a field's `requiredPermissions`, feed the result masker over the record the route gets back, and the visitor gets the `id` only;
    - so a deployment registers one only to mask fields on that record, and nothing else needs it;
    - no hook can read `permissions` or `anonymous`, so a public submission is told apart by the missing `ctx.user`.
  - Section 2's `os:check` snippet, which declared an INSERT-only set, is removed: its whole content was object bits that nothing reads. The section stays because a reader who sees `permissions: ['guest_portal']` in the context shape needs to know what that name does.
  - The auth-model bullet no longer says `permissions: ['guest_portal']` "is retained for back-compat".
- **`examples/app-crm/src/objects/lead.object.ts`, the `status` comment only.** It no longer says an option default is "only a UI preselect". It now says the declared `defaultValue: 'new'` is what the write uses, and that this takes precedence over the `default: true` option, which the engine falls back to on write only for a select that declares no `defaultValue`.

Evidence:

- The two probes in H1 above. On the CRM with and without `GuestPortalProfile`, the answers were identical, and the `beforeInsert` hook saw `ctx.session` / `ctx.user` unset. On the engine, the positive control showed that `permissions` and `anonymous` never reach a hook. The CRM probe also stored `source: web` for a select that declares no `defaultValue`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, about `:7086`: "A field that declares NO `defaultValue` falls back to the option marked `default: true` ({@link resolveOptionDefault}, #7246)". The `applyFieldDefaults` branch reaches `resolveOptionDefault(f)` only when `f.defaultValue == null`, so a declared `defaultValue` wins.

Tests and gates on `91ca7f3b7`, every exit captured before any pipe:

- **Build.** `pnpm turbo run build` over the round-0 closure plus the eight packages the two dist-reading gates need: `Tasks: 74 successful, 74 total`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The CRM's `objectstack build` re-ran on the new `lead.object.ts`: `✓ Build complete`, `Security: 3 Positions  2 Permissions`.
- **CRM tests and typecheck.** `@objectstack/example-crm` `vitest run`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 46 passed (46)`, exit 0. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Lint.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config examples/app-crm/src/objects/lead.object.ts`: exit 0, no output.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave the same 93 commands as round 0, and all 93 exit 0 on the first pass. `check:skill-examples` reads "262 prose examples type-check" (263 before: the removed snippet); `check:doc-anchors` reads "536 internal #fragment link(s) … all resolve". `--ran`: "Run reconciliation — 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- **Stale-tree note.** The derivation warned that the tree is 5 commits behind `origin/main` and that one derived gate, `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`, changed there (#24236). I also ran `main`'s copy of that script at its own path against this tree, restored by `git checkout HEAD` and proved by blob hash (`bd90f10a6`, the HEAD blob): scan exit 0, `--self-test` exit 0 (39 cases).

## Patch round 2

**Patch round 2** fixes the `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` row of `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`'s submit error table, and nothing else. The claim was revised for it (comment 6243651386, "Revised 2026-10-18T01:33Z … patch round 2"). Head: `860ca38a9`. `main` did not move on `forms.mdx`, so it was not merged.

The row said "the resolved profile does not allow create on the target object", which contradicted section 2 on the same page. It now names the conditions the submit answers `403` for, each measured by a throwaway dogfood probe (deleted, never committed) through the real `POST /api/v1/forms/:slug/submit` on one `bootStack` boot:

| case | answer |
|---|---|
| baseline submit | `201` |
| permission-set resolution throws (fault injected on the boot's own `SecurityPlugin` instance) | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` "[Security] Access denied: permission subsystem unavailable for operation 'insert' …"; after restore `201` |
| the object's security posture unresolved (fault injected) | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` "… the security posture of object '…' could not be resolved …"; after restore `201` |
| a code-registered `beforeInsert` hook throws `PermissionDeniedError` | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the hook's message |
| a code-registered hook throws a plain `Error` (control) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| an `afterInsert` hook writes a different object through `ctx.api`, unelevated | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` "[Security] Access denied: public-form grant permits only create/read-back on 'pfx_cross', not 'insert' on 'pfx_other'" |
| a declarative (sandboxed) `beforeInsert` hook throws | `400`, the hook's message |

The first two arms are the grant branch's fail-closed throws in `security-plugin.ts`; the cross-object arm is its refusal of any operation outside the grant, and it shows that a hook's nested write carries the submission's context. A permission set's object bits appear in none of them.

Gates on `860ca38a9`, every exit captured before any pipe: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave the same 93 commands as round 1, and all 93 exit 0. `--ran`: "Run reconciliation — 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:doc-anchors` and `check:doc-authoring` are green. The same stale-tree note as round 1 applies, and `main`'s copy of `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`, run again at its own path with a trap restore proved by blob hash (`bd90f10a6`), exits 0 on scan and on `--self-test`. The build for the probe was `Tasks: 74 successful, 74 total` (all cached), lock `VERDICT` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

None of these sites is changed here. Each needs a carrier. The `forms.mdx` and `lead.object.ts` items that were listed here in round 0 are fixed in patch round 1 above, and the `forms.mdx` `403` row listed here in round 1 is fixed in patch round 2.

- **`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` about `:87`** describes the submit context as `{ permissions: ['guest_portal'], anonymous: true }` and omits `publicFormGrant`. This is a governed surface (Tier H); the seat files it as a card to its lane.
- **`anonymous: true` on the submit context has no reader.** There are zero non-test property reads of `anonymous` in `packages/` (pattern `(\.|\?\.)anonymous\b|\[['"]anonymous['"]\]`), against 1 for the control key `publicFormGrant` with the same pattern, at `5a9a80bd2`. The card changes no behaviour, so the key stays.
- **ADR-0096's census row** for `rest-server.ts#enforceAuth` reads "fall open when `guest_portal` unregistered (partly mitigated by the `publicFormGrant`)". It is an accepted record's census, a governed surface, and left as is.
